history.content: I rebooted my phone as you asked, but I still have no signal—there are no bars showing on the screen.

Thank you for letting me know. Let’s continue troubleshooting your signal issue. Please follow these steps on your phone:

1. Check your status bar and let me know if you see any of these icons:
   - Airplane mode (✈️)
   - No signal (📵)
   - Signal bars (📶)
   - Any network type (5G, 4G, etc.)

This will help me determine the next steps to resolve your issue. What do you see in your phone’s status bar?
I actually see excellent signal bars, 5G, and it says Data Enabled and Connected to Chestnut-5G in the status bar. What should I try next?

Thank you for the details. Since your status bar shows excellent signal, 5G, and data is enabled, your phone is connected to the network. If you still cannot make calls or send messages, let’s check for possible SIM or network configuration issues.

Please let me know if you see any error messages when you try to make a call or send a message. Also, can you confirm if you are able to use mobile data (for example, browsing the internet without Wi-Fi)?

Meanwhile, I recommend the following steps:
1. Try making a call and note any error message.
2. Try sending a text message and note any error message.
3. Turn off Wi-Fi temporarily and try browsing the internet using mobile data.

Let me know the results, and if there are any error messages, please share them. This will help me guide you further.
I tried making a call and it works now. I can also send messages and browse the internet with mobile data after turning off Wi-Fi. Everything seems to be working perfectly now.

That’s great to hear! Your service has been fully restored, and everything is working as expected.

If you experience any other issues or have questions about your plan, billing, or technical support in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a wonderful day!
